## MIDSEA Summer School 2025

**23 - 29 June 2025 · Yogyakarta, Indonesia**, hosted by Universitas Gadjah
Mada, following on from a successful 2024 event in Vietnam.

- Parallel tracks addressing both foundational and advanced disease
  modelling concepts
- Networking opportunities with modellers across Southeast Asia and beyond

### What's included

- Seven days of sessions
- Keynote speakers
- Hands-on workshops
- Networking meals
- Open discussion forums
- Coffee and tea breaks
- Certificate of attendance

### Programme schedule

| Day | Date | Activity |
|---|---|---|
| Sunday | 22 June | Arrival |
| Monday - Saturday | 23 - 28 June | Morning classes (Modelling 101, Simulation, Inference, AI, Specialised topics) and afternoon workshops |
| Wednesday | 25 June | Excursion day |
| Sunday - Monday | 29 - 30 June | Conference and departure |

### Registration fees

| Category | Accommodation | Fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| LMIC | Twin share | 600 |
| LMIC | Single | 900 |
| HIC | Twin share | 1200 |
| HIC | Single | 1600 |

Fees vary by region and accommodation type. LMIC/HIC classifications follow
the World Bank's country classifications.

### Scholarships

A limited number of scholarships are available. To be eligible, applicants
must:

- Be residents of an LMIC (as classified by the World Bank)
- Self-fund their own travel
- Commit to attending the full programme
- Accept twin-share accommodation

Scholarship notifications go out by 14 April 2025.

### How to register

Complete [the registration form linked here](#) by 2 April 2025. Early
submission is encouraged as places are limited.
